_comment: REJECTION FIXTURE: a DELETE declared non-destructive, cacheable, running without approval, and whose whenToUse never demands the merchant explicitly asked. The structural gate rejects the governance contradictions; the semantic gate rejects the weak intent hints. Together they would let an agent cache the removal of a coupon it was never clearly asked to remove.

interface.name: delete_coupon_unsafe
interface.title: Delete Coupon
interface.description: Deletes a discount coupon from the store permanently.
whenToUse: The merchant wants a coupon removed from the store.
whenNotToUse: The merchant wants to disable it temporarily -- update its status instead.
